_doc: Zone art for Raza (rid 300), docs/adr/0003 pass 3. Each building lists a region (blockout glTF metres [x0, z0, x1, z1], x east, z south) whose blockout faces are rebuilt as art by tools/blender/build_zone_art.py and hidden from the rendered blockout by tools/ue/build_world.py (the full blockout stays as collision). Ground-level floors in the region stay in the blockout. `scatter`: ground decoration per floor texture (tools/environment/scatter.py).

buildings.name: Hall
buildings._doc: raz-bldg-h: the stone hall with stained-glass windows and the clock tower over the door.

scatter.name: grass
scatter._doc: Grass tufts on the original grass floors (grd02306/02301) and sparser between the stones of the grass-stone path (grd09603). Meshes: tools/blender/build_grass_kit.py.
